findings.rule: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: 'New', 'Novel', 'First', 'Unprecedented', or other similar descriptive words, and their adjectives.
findings.problem: The title begins with the word 'Novel': 'Novel coarse-grained model of allosteric communication in a ring-shaped ATPase'.

findings.rule: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required.
findings.problem: The abstract is approximately 330 words, exceeding the 250-word limit by about 80 words.

findings.rule: The abstract must not include references.
findings.problem: The abstract contains the citation '[12]' in the sentence about Brownian dynamics simulations reproducing the sequential firing order.

findings.rule: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: 'New', 'Novel', 'First', 'Unprecedented', or other similar descriptive words, and their adjectives.
findings.problem: The abstract states 'We further demonstrate for the first time that truncating the C-terminal helix…', using the prohibited word 'first'.

findings.rule: A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.
findings.problem: Seven keywords are listed (elastic network model, allostery, ring ATPase, normal mode analysis, coarse-grained simulation, molecular motor, Brownian dynamics), exceeding the limit of five.

findings.rule: A short statement of less than 100 words about the significance of the paper should be added.
findings.problem: The Significance statement is approximately 123 words, exceeding the 100-word limit.

findings.rule: The required section order is: …Discussion, Conclusion, Conflict of interest, Author contributions, Data availability, (preprint comment), Acknowledgements, References.
findings.problem: The 'Conclusion' section is entirely missing from the manuscript.

findings.rule: The required section order places 'Conflict of interest' before 'Author contributions'.
findings.problem: The manuscript places 'Author contributions' before 'Conflict of interest', reversing the required order.

findings.rule: A 'Data availability' section is required in the specified order.
findings.problem: No Data availability section is present anywhere in the manuscript.

findings.rule: The required order places 'Acknowledgements' before 'References'.
findings.problem: The manuscript lists 'References' before 'Acknowledgements', reversing the required order.

findings.rule: The use of 'in preparation' and 'submitted for publication' is not allowed in the Reference list.
findings.problem: Reference [5] reads: 'Nishimura, R., Morisawa, K. Directional coupling in driven elastic networks. In preparation.'

findings.rule: References to 'unpublished data' and 'personal communications' should not appear in the reference list, but appear parenthetically in the text.
findings.problem: Reference [8] is 'Kuramoto, H. Personal communication, 2025.' — a personal communication listed in the reference list rather than cited parenthetically in the text.

findings.rule: All references should be listed in numerical order; References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text.
findings.problem: The reference list is not in numerical order: [5] is followed by [7], then [6], then [8]. Reference [7] (Ikeguchi) appears before [6] (Togashi).

findings.rule: When the Reference has a DOI, it should be added by its URL (e.g., https://doi.org/…).
findings.problem: Reference [4] uses the format 'doi:10.1016/S0006-3495(01)76033-X' instead of the required 'https://doi.org/10.1016/S0006-3495(01)76033-X'.

findings.rule: Abbreviated Journal titles follow the Index Medicus/MEDLINE format.
findings.problem: The journal is written as 'Biophysical Journal' instead of the MEDLINE abbreviation 'Biophys. J.' (as shown in the journal's own example reference).

findings.rule: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by 'et al.'
findings.problem: Reference [9] lists all nine authors (Adachi, Oiwa, Nishizaka, Furuike, Noji, Itoh, Yoshida, Kinosita, Tanaka) instead of the first six followed by 'et al.'

findings.rule: When the Reference has a DOI, it should be added by its URL.
findings.problem: Reference [11] ('Itoh, H., … Nature (in press).') is missing the DOI URL. The journal's own example for this same article includes 'https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212'.

findings.rule: A Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required.
findings.problem: The running title 'Coarse-grained elastic network analysis of allosteric coupling in ring ATPases' is 78 characters, exceeding the 50-character limit.

findings.rule: We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats.
findings.problem: Fig1_modes.bmp and Fig2_spectra.bmp are in BMP format, which is not among the accepted formats (TIFF, PNG, JPEG, PDF).

findings.rule: Electronic files of photographs and illustrations should be at 300 dpi resolution.
findings.problem: Fig1_modes.bmp and Fig2_spectra.bmp are listed at 150 dpi, below the required 300 dpi.

findings.rule: The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.
findings.problem: The graphical abstract is submitted as 'Graphical_abstract.tiff' (TIFF), which is not in the accepted list of PNG, JPEG, or GIF.

findings.rule: Please also upload a short caption less than 100 words about the figure(s).
findings.problem: The graphical abstract caption is approximately 134 words, exceeding the 100-word limit.

findings.rule: The caption … should not duplicate the title of the article or the Significance statement.
findings.problem: The first sentence of the caption ('Novel coarse-grained model of allosteric communication in a ring-shaped ATPase') is identical to the article title.

findings.rule: Do not include spaces or Japanese characters (multi-byte codes) in the file name or the file path: Please use alphanumeric characters only. The file name extension should be one of the following: pdf, txt, zip, mpeg or avi.
findings.problem: The file name '図1_final version.tiff' contains a Japanese character (図), a space, and uses the .tiff extension which is not in the accepted list (pdf, txt, zip, mpeg, avi).

findings.rule: Movie files in MPEG or AVI format; file name extension should be one of: pdf, txt, zip, mpeg or avi.
findings.problem: The file 'Suppl_Movie_1.mov' uses the .mov (QuickTime) extension, which is not MPEG or AVI and is not in the accepted extension list.

findings.rule: All tables must be cited in the text.
findings.problem: Table 1 (Bead and spring counts) is not cited anywhere in the main text. Only Table 2 is referenced.

findings.rule: Supply a short explanatory title above the body of the table.
findings.problem: The title 'Table 2 | Dependence of the fitted susceptibility length constants on the nucleotide stiffening factor s.' appears below the table body rather than above it.

findings.rule: Table footnotes lettered a, b, c, and so forth, below the body of the table.
findings.problem: Table 1 footnotes are numbered '1.', '2.', '3.' instead of lettered 'a.', 'b.', 'c.' as required.

findings.rule: When referring to macromolecular structures, please use [PDB ID: <PDB ID>] (https://doi.org/10.2210/pdb<PDB ID>/pdb) in the text.
findings.problem: The text reads '(PDB 6qw9)' instead of the required format '[PDB ID: 6qw9] (https://doi.org/10.2210/pdb6qw9/pdb)'.

findings.rule: The complete postal address and the ORCID iD of the corresponding author should be indicated on the footer of page 1.
findings.problem: The corresponding author block gives only 'Kyoto' as the address (no street, city district, or postal code) and does not include an ORCID iD.

findings.rule: A comment about deposition to a preprint server … e.g. A preliminary version of this work was deposited in arXiv (ID, DOI or URL) on August 13, 2020.
findings.problem: The preprint statement 'A preliminary version of this work was deposited in bioRxiv on 4 March 2026' omits the required bioRxiv ID, DOI, or URL.
